build_BaseGraphNeuralNetworkLayer: build a BaseGraphNeuralNetworkLayer instance with global, molecular graph, GNN, and regularization config objects
create_get_edge_features: create edge features by concatenating atomic, direction, and distance embeddings from GraphAttentionData
create_get_edge_linear: create a linear layer for edge features combining distance, direction, and atom embedding sizes
create_get_node_features: create node features by mapping and concatenating sender and receiver features using a neighbor list
refactor_aggregate: refactor the aggregate method to use masked mean aggregation over neighbor edge features instead of returning the first element
